record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly reduce Adam learning rate from 1e-3 to 7e-4 and increase embedding dropout from 0.1 to 0.15. Smaller updates may stabilize optimization under stronger input regularization, improving generalization without changing model capacity. Retain dimensions, depth, history length, loss, readout and scoring; keep seed 42, the 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch. Train and load exactly one checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, increase input dropout to 0.15 and reduce Adam learning rate to 7e-4. Stronger regularization paired with smaller updates may improve generalization while retaining current capacity. Architecture, loss, readout, checkpoint shapes, routing and training limits remain unchanged; the predictor requires no changes.
